# @surfaces-ui/components

React components for Surfaces UI.

The components themselves: grids that stay fast at any size, charts, pivots, the SQL editor, schema and catalog browsing, data modelling, filters and the theme. Every one reads data through a `DataSource`, so they work with this library's server, your own backend, or rows in memory.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/components react react-dom
```

`react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies: your app provides them.

## Use

```tsx
import { Chart, DataGrid, DataSourceProvider, ThemeProvider } from "@surfaces-ui/components";
import { memoryDataSource } from "@surfaces-ui/data";
import "@surfaces-ui/components/styles.css";

const data = memoryDataSource({ tables: { orders: [{ region: "EU", amount: 120 }, { region: "NA", amount: 80 }] } });

export function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      <DataSourceProvider dataSource={data}>
        <Chart sourceId="memory" sql="SELECT * FROM orders" type="bar" x="region" y={[{ column: "amount", aggregate: "sum" }]} />
        <DataGrid sourceId="memory" sql="SELECT * FROM orders" height={300} />
      </DataSourceProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
